listings.description:

It has been a great summer car, I'm 62 and have not abused it in any way, never seen a track day. Insurance is not bad, and MPG is ~20 surprisingly good. Clean tiitle and no accidents.
Interior is perfect, back seats are unused because they are unusable for people over ~3 feet tall... under the hood is clean, trunk is amazingly big!
Only reason for sale is want to buy a C7 Corvette just to change things up a little, I love sports cars. This color Rapid Red + PP1 is kind of rare and definately has the look to set it apart, I have not seen another one around Mpls. 
The PP1 cars like this are the ones to get over a normal GT or GT premium: 
 - Performance Wheels & Tires: 19×9" front and 19×9.5" rear Ebony Black-painted aluminum wheels 
255/40R19 (front) and 275/40R19 (rear). Tires are in great shape, about 15K on them.
 - Braking Upgrades: Brembo™ six‑piston front brake calipers with large rotors 
 - Suspension & Chassis: Heavy‑duty front springs, K‑brace (steeda) for improved chassis rigidity, Strut‑tower brace.
 - Cooling: Larger radiator for improved heat dissipation 
 - Aero & Styling: Functional rear spoiler, Larger front lip and side skirts.
 - Interior & Instrumentation: Engine‑spun aluminum instrument panel.
 - Gauge pack: Vacuum and Oil Pressure gage upper center of dash.

I did 2 modifications: These 2 "bolt ons" are a big improvement for the Coyote Engine that required no change to tune or engine modification and didn't affect warentee - Just help it breath in and flow out better, adding ~15 HP, taking it from 460 to ~475 hp. 
 - Corsa cold air intake. The OEM air box is included. This just flows and sounds better far better for intake. $435
 - Borla 60662 SwitchFire X-Pipe Exhaust Pipe. The OEM H pipe also does not flow smoothly. This thing sounds amazing and should for $600. The active exhaust is all retaind so you can program Quiet, Normal, Sport, Track. The cold start will let the neighbors know when you are going to work! Or you can program it or start quiet in the morning.

listings.title: 2003 MINI Cooper S
listings.description:
2003 Mini Cooper S
Very clean, 38 mpg, COLD A/C, HOT heat, Supercharged with 6 speed manual. Very fun car to drive!
Background on the car- Bought the car from a 45 year old Mini Cooper enthusiast. He was very meticulous and knew absolutely everything about a Mini Cooper a guy could know, and he had a few different Mini's. He did the normal tasteful modifications to the car for a Mini Cooper of its Era as well as maintenance too. Supercharger oil, pulley, Alta tune, Alta air filter, cat back exhuast, Cooling fan relay mod, larger intercooler. I have had zero issues with the car in the last several years ive owned it. My Wife and I just drove it out to Green Bay, WI recently (4.5hr one way; 9hr round trip). Thats how dependable and trustworthy it is... and we have 3 other daily drivers to use. I just drive it and listen to the cool supercharger noises. I dont beat on it, I never race it, I just drive it to commute around (it fits everywhere) and its fun to drive around. 
-Car is equipped with the fuel efficient 1.6L Supercharged 4 cylinder engine. Powerful and peppy powertrain for the car. The car is rated at 38MPG on the highway and around 29MPG in city type driving and it gets at least that if not better. Very smooth and comfortable car with regular maintenance completed. I bought the car about 3 years ago because I've always wanted a Mini, fun to drive, it fits in any parking spot, and the great fuel mileage. Car has mostly been commuted on the freeway and has very well maintained easy highway miles... has roughly 161k miles on it. Has newer brakes, oil change, etc recently done.
-Mechanically the car is great in my opinion considering the age. The engine runs as smooth as a swiss watch and has all of the power that it did like it was new (actually significantly more). Has no issues that would need attention (just drove it 9hrs round trip)!! The transmission shifts perfectly and nice and smooth, clutch is in good shape and it is very easy to drive. The steering is nice and tight and drives straight down the road. The brakes are powerful and responsive (newer). The suspension rides great and is tight and comfortable. Tires are still good, about 70% tread remaining. HOT Heat and COLD A/C!!!!!!
It is a 2003 Mini so with that its not perfect but miniscule such as the parking brake needs to be adjusted, the drivers window needs to be adjusted (I put a window regulator in and I didnt get it adjusted perfect but its very close), could use a valve cover gasket if you wanted but not needed right away. Id drive it to any state in the country today from AZ to FL to NY and not think twice. 
-Car is equipped nicely.... Heated seats (very hot and work great), power windows, power locks, power mirrors, Great Stereo, Navigation that does work, Map lights, rear seats fold down, CRUISE CONTROL, 6 way adjust seat, Lots of storage compartments, remote trunk release, Keyless entry, and much more that im sure im forgetting.
-The interior is in great shape and clean, no major staining. It has the rare and sought after blue leather interior. Nearly no visible signs of any type of wear on the seats, carpet, buttons etc. It really is that nice. the car has been kept perfectly clean and treated with respect. Everything on the interior works... windows, buttons, lights etc, everything.
-The exterior is clean for the year of the vehicle. Paint has a great glossy shine to it. Has no major body damage or major dents. Car was always kept clean on the outside just like it was on the inside and it shows. It does have the typical parking lot door ding and scratch/scuff... you have to look for them but they are there here or there. Minor rust bubble on the rear but nothing major or noticeable. 
Very reliable car that needs nothing but a driver. All maintenance done and is ready to go. We would drive this car across country over and over and not think twice.
Clean and clear title in hand signed and ready to go.

listings.title: 2014 Scion Xb Wagon
listings.description:
Selling my Toaster. 
Those that know Xb’s love them. Same here, this box is awesome.
 The Only reason I’m selling it is that I’m out of driveway space. 
The car is mostly OEM. I updated most of the lights to LED. 
I have stayed up to date on scheduled maintenance per the maintenance schedule book. 
Plugs replaced recently (per maintenance schedule)
Oil was changed approx 200 miles ago. Same with transmission fluid. It has been done every 80,000 miles. 
Currently on odo is just over 180,000. These Toyota cars easily get 250,000. There is a lot of life left in it. 
It has had 2 accidents. First was an inattentive driver entering the road and hit the car in the driver side rear wheel. Repair was new wheel and rear fender cover. 
The 2nd was this last winter when a deer was hit at 30mph. The repair was new front bumper cover, passenger fender, wheel-well liner some other plastic parts and I replaced both headlights at the same time since it was apart and easy. 
These box’s are simple to work on which makes them popular in the mod circles. 
Currently averaging 29-30 mpg. 
It pulls hard to 100mph. 
This is a great car, tons of interior space, is safe and maintained. 
Only way to appreciate it is to try it. 
Price is negotiable but I do have a low limit and I’m not desperate to unload the car. 
Until it sells, this is still a daily driver. Weekdays it will be in Green Lake; evenings and weekends it is in Omro. 
Call and text is best. If you call, leave a message and I’ll call back as fast as I can. 
Single owner and never left Wisconsin. 
910 (yes, fort Bragg area code- I won’t change it) 
551-388 four. 
Jon

listings.description:
Own a piece of automotive history with this authentic 1966 Ford Mustang GT 2+2 Fastback. A true survivor vehicle, it features its original A-Code 289 CID 4BBL V8 engine paired with a classic 4-speed manual transmission. Carefully maintained within a private collection for over two decades, this vintage muscle car combines incredible originality with reliable performance.
The exterior is dressed in a factory-correct Turquoise Metallic paint finish applied over 20 years ago, highlighting excellent chrome accents, trim, and all-original glass. Inside, the cabin features the iconic original turquoise-and-white Pony Interior, complete with comfortable bucket seats, a full center console, a convenient fold-down rear seat, rally pack gauges, and a factory tachometer. All interior lights and the clock remain fully operational.
Further adding to its charm, this classic fastback includes a Cobra engine dress-up kit, an unmodified trunk and undercarriage, classic rally wheels, and a preserved 1979 Georgia State inspection sticker pointing to its rich Southern heritage. Freshly serviced with a new fuel tank, fresh fluids, a professional tune-up, new tires, and a replacement battery, this vintage Mustang GT Fastback is completely ready to drive, show, and enjoy.

A true survivor vehicle, it features its original A-Code 289 CID 4BBL V8 engine paired with a classic 4-speed manual transmission. Carefully maintained within a private collection for over two decades, this vintage muscle car combines incredible originality with reliable performance.

Inside, the cabin features the iconic original turquoise-and-white Pony Interior, complete with comfortable bucket seats, a full center console, a convenient fold-down rear seat, rally pack gauges, and a factory tachometer. All interior lights and the clock remain fully operational.

listings.title: 2008 MINI Cooper Hatchback
listings.description:
For sale is a 2008 Mini Cooper. I am the second owner. I've owned it since 167,000 miles.
Look at known issues below. It is not a perfect car, but it's enjoyable to drive. I've enjoyed it two summers. But I am the only one in my family that can drive stick and we need a car that is automatic that we all can share.
I frequently drive this car between Eau Claire, Menomonie, and the Twin Cities. I drive this car pretty conservatively, so I am getting consistently 45 mpg with it. It takes premium gas.
Recently replaced:
• spark plugs
• rear brakes, rotors, and calipers
• oil change about 1,500 miles ago
Known issues:
• oil leak - needs a quart of oil every 1,000-1,500 miles
• exhaust leak - it makes a little noise, and when the heat is on and you're sitting at a stoplight you can smell a little bit of it (I just turn the heat off if the car is idling for a while)
• passenger power window is finicky - it works fine, but it can't go all the way up sometimes--you have to work it up gently
• air conditioning does not work - it has not work for about two years - I never looked into it
• tires - the back two tires leak air, one more than the other - I usually have to air them up once a week
• driver's seat has wear and is torn
• center console information display (time, audio input) sometimes is faded and can't see it

I have the hardtop lift that makes for easy one man on and off operation and makes for great storage when the soft top is on. I do have the back seat not shown in the pictures and all the rear seatbelt equipment that is currently removed! I have come to this difficult decision to part ways because it sits more than ever driven and I just don’t have the space without having to rent a storage for it! I guess the realization that it’s time to downsize! Any questions, please feel free to reach out!
Thank you!

listings.title: 2006 Hyundai Tucson Limited
listings.description:
This is a one owner car being sold by the original owner. The 2.7 liter V6 engine runs great. We have always serviced and repaired any mechanical problems with this vehicle. This includes, within its most recent 13,000 miles, a front brake job, installation of good new tires, full repair of the exhaust system, a new starter assembly and wiring harness, new engine and cabin air filters, a new battery, a new power steering system hose and new rear brake lines and a rear brake job. The oil and filter were most recently changed last month. All electrical systems, lights, indicators and controls, including the audio system (6 CD changer, cassette, AM/FM) and sunroof work except as noted below.
 The parking brake froze several years ago, and we had it disabled on the advice of our mechanic. The car holds fine in park.
 The “TPMS” (Tire Pressure Monitoring System) dashboard light is stuck on. The tires have less than 13,000 miles, and we regularly check the tire pressure, which has always been good.
 The driver’s seat has some small tears. We have installed patches over the rips as seen in the photo.
 The little drawer next to the 12v outlet under the center stack is stuck open as seen in the photo.
 The AC is not quite as strong as it used to be. I give it a little AC Pro recharge before summer and it carries me through the warm weather comfortably.
The car has never been in an accident, and the exterior is in good condition for its age. Virtually no rust anywhere. There is a 1 1/4” receiver hitch on the car. This was only ever used for bike carriers. The car has never been used to tow anything.
Except as to the driver’s seat, the interior is in very good condition for its age. The car has never been smoked in. This was the top of the line when bought, and the car includes cruise control, front seat heaters, a power sunroof, a day/night mirror with compass, an upgraded audio system, a cargo area privacy shield that can be easily removed for loading larger items and a roof rack.
Because of the car’s age the sale of course will be on an “AS IS” basis, Sale for cash only (or a cashier’s or certified check). The asking price is well within KBB estimated sale values for this car with this mileage. Please no low-ball or trade offers.
Some extras: I will include the aftermarket Car Play/Android Auto system seen in the photos after I reset it. It works well as both a Navigation system and for playing music from a bluetooth connected phone. The sale will also include the original owner’s manual for the car.
Please contact me through the Craigslist reply system if you are interested, preferably including a text/phone number where I can reach you.

listings.description:
2010 BMW 528i (E60), the last model year of the E60. 3.0L N52 naturally aspirated
inline-6, 6-speed automatic, rear-wheel drive. 122,028 miles (dash photo taken
11/19/2026) with no warning lights. Clean title, registered in Michigan. VIN
.
California car until we moved to Michigan this spring, and it has never been driven in
snow. We bought it in 2025 from the original owner.
OVER $10,500 IN DOCUMENTED RECEIPTS, NOV 2025 TO JUL 2026 (I can email redacted
copies):
- Nov 2025, $5,994.79: oil pan gasket, rear brakes, both lower control arms, two
engine mounts, alignment, trunk latch, seat track, one Michelin Pilot Super Sport tire
- Nov 2025, $789.77: xenon bulbs, washer pump, OEM mirror
- Jan 2026, $1,621.79: staggered Drag DR-87 19" wheels (19x8.5 ET22 front, 19x9.5 ET30
rear, 5x120) with TPMS kits, plus a Michelin Pilot Sport 4S tire
- Mar 2026, $1,865.38: fuel pump assembly, fuel filter, hood switch
- Jul 2026, $259.88: Autobahn Imports (St. Joseph) installed a driver-side mirror and
filled out a check sheet. Coolant good to -20F, battery 800 CCA.
EQUIPMENT: power sunroof, heated front seats, dual-zone automatic climate control,
power front seats with 2-position driver memory, xenon headlights.
ADD-ONS: window tint, front and rear cameras with a larger rearview-mirror display,
Nirius NFC tag, cupholder phone mount, carbon-look wrap on the front cabin trim (rear
doors keep the factory wood). The staggered wheels and the trim were the previous
owner's choices.
HONEST FLAWS (all shown in the photos):
- Crease in the trunk lid, small dents near the rear quarter panel, scuffs on the
lower front bumper
- Hazy headlight lenses
- Torn underhood insulation pad
- Some camera wiring is visible
- The tint is aftermarket. Michigan limits front side window tint, so you may want the
front film removed.
- Mixed tire models (Michelin Pilot Sport 4S and Pilot Super Sport)
- The July 2026 check sheet noted that the front passenger shock is leaking, and that
spark plugs, the cabin filter, and the engine air filter are due by mileage if they weren't done at the 100,000 Mi service. I think the previous owner probably did them, but I don't have his records.
PLATES: Michigan only requires a rear plate. The California plate on the front in some
photos is our old, expired plate from before the move. No plates come with the car.
Showings and test drives start Friday, November 27, by appointment. Please bring your
driver's license.
PAYMENT: cash counted at my bank, or a cashier's check verified with the issuing bank.
No PayPal, Venmo, Zelle, personal checks, or buyer-arranged shipping or escrow. Title
signed over in person.
$6,200 OBO. To help me filter out bots, please include the word N52 in your first
message.

listings.description:
2013 Ford F-150 SuperCab XLT, Road-Trip Ready
Selling my reliable 2013 Ford F-150 SuperCab. It has been a fantastic road-trip truck, and the only reason I’m letting it go is that it doesn’t fit in my new garage.
History & Condition
• Clean Body: Purchased in Minnesota in 2021 at 115,000 miles, though service records show it spent most of its life in Arizona. Before its first winter with me, I had the bed sprayed with Line-X and the undercarriage professionally undercoated by Line-X to protect against rust. The body is very clean for its age.
• Mechanical: One of the turbos was replaced shortly after I bought it in 2021, and it has been completely reliable and smooth-running ever since.
• Fuel Capacity: Equipped with the 36-gallon extended-range fuel tank, making it ideal for long road trips.
Upgrades & Features
• Wheels & Tires: KMC KM717 wheels (17x8.5, +18mm offset) wrapped in Toyo Open Country A/T III tires (P285/70R17).
• Infotainment: Upgraded touchscreen head unit with wireless Apple CarPlay and wireless Android Auto.
• Custom Bed Platform: Includes a sturdy, custom-built wooden bed platform. Its great for truck camping or keeping groceries and gear from sliding around on the rough Line-X liner. It is easy to take out, and I’m happy to remove it before the sale if you don't want it.
Known Issue
• TPMS Sensor: One tire pressure sensor intermittently drops out after a couple of hours of highway driving, which triggers a dash warning light. To clear the error you just need to hit ok on the steering wheel.
It’s been a great, dependable truck that I would keep if I had a bigger garage. Clean title in hand.

listings.title: 2010 Lexus RX450H awd
listings.description:
Selling my 2010 Lexus RX 450h AWD hybrid SUV with approximately 167,000 miles. Black exterior, clean title, and originally a California vehicle.
The vehicle runs and drives normally. It has a known hybrid battery issue, detailed below, which is reflected in the asking price.
I've already purchased a larger vehicle and don't have the space to keep both. I also don't have the time to address the remaining repairs, so I've decided to sell as-is.
FEATURES
3.5L V6 hybrid engine with all-wheel drive
Factory navigation system
Backup camera
Heated and ventilated leather front seats
Power sunroof
Keyless entry and push-button start
Dual-zone automatic climate control
MAINTENANCE WORK DONE
2022 – Engine replacement and major mechanical work: Following a catalytic converter theft that resulted in damage to the coolant lines and subsequent engine overheating, the gasoline engine was replaced with a used engine from a 2011 Lexus RX 450h with approximately 92,000 miles at installation. Extensive mechanical work was completed as part of the replacement. The engine has performed reliably since, including during a cross-country drive.
February 2026 – 12V auxiliary battery replaced.
June 2024 – Both rear shock absorbers replaced.
June 2024 – Catalytic converter anti-theft protection installed.
June 2022 – Exhaust system repaired following catalytic converter theft.
Regular synthetic oil changes - will need one soon.
May 2026 – Passed Illinois emissions testing.
Maintenance and repair documentation available.
CURRENT CONDITION
The vehicle runs and drives normally, with no noticeable performance issues.
Exterior: Normal wear consistent with age. Originally a California vehicle, with no significant visible rust observed.
Interior: Normal wear for its age, including some minor tears in the driver's seat.
Tires: Low tread and will need replacement.
HYBRID BATTERY ISSUE:
The vehicle intermittently triggers diagnostic code P0A80 (Replace Hybrid Battery Pack), approximately every few days.
The warning is cleared using an OBD scanner but eventually returns. The vehicle continues to drive normally, including when the warning appears, without noticeable changes in performance.
I am not sure whether the battery itself needs replacement or if there is something else causing the issue. Either way, the car drives fine and I clear the code with a small scanner that plugs in via Bluetooth. You can do it while driving as well. 
PRICE & SALE DETAILS
Asking $4,000 OBO.
Clean title. Maintenance and repair records available.
Vehicle is being sold as-is, with the known hybrid battery issue.

listings.title: 2011 Infiniti G25X Sedan
listings.description:
We spent 4 months looking for a clean G25 just to get rear ended 5 days later. No rips or tears on seats and interior is like new. The insurance company totaled it out and I’m debating on keeping it. It was a high hit so the rear body panel may be salvageable. Quarters look good. Needs a deck lid, bumper and lights. The foam absorber does not appear to be damaged. The underside is clean with minimal rust and everything still works as it should. It would make a really nice repairable for a guy with a smaller body shop. 
It will be for sale until Monday and if nobody wants it I’m going to probably just let the insurance company come and take it as I do not have the time right now to fix or wait for a buyer. It is still drivable as the airbags did not deploy and it still drive straight and fine based on the 50 miles or so that we drove it since the accident. Drive at your own risk however. 
We would have to write up a bill of sale and then when I get the plates and title from the state we can meet up and I can give them to you. 
I included a portion of the Carfax but due to Facebooks photo limitations it’s not complete. I can provide interested buyers a copy if interested. The title is currently clean and the insurance company advised state law says it’s below the total loss threshold, however, it may still show as a total as the insurance company feels it would cost more to repair it than to just pay the value for it.
